name: mfe-ecommerce-assignment
description: Dev convenience launcher only — each app (shell/home/product/shop) remains independent with its own package.json and can be run/deployed on its own.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n home,product,shop,shell -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix home run dev" "npm --prefix product run dev" "npm --prefix shop run dev" "npm --prefix shell run dev"
